stories.title: More than 600 children a day using Flintshire summer playschemes
stories.summary: More than 600 children a day are attending Flintshire’s free summer playschemes, with places still open at some of the 49 sites running through the holidays. stories.summary: The footway alongside Hawarden Bridge closes on Monday, and six days later the railway over it shuts for a fortnight. stories.title: Free tours of 1877 Hawarden building as part of Cadw Open Doors day
stories.summary: Hawarden Masonic Hall will open to the public for free tours on Saturday 12 September as part of Cadw Open Doors. The grade II listed building on Gladstone Way is one of several buildings in Hawarden taking part in the scheme, which is run by Cadw, the Welsh Government’s historic environment service. stories.summary: Roads through Mold town centre will close to traffic between 11am and 2pm on Friday 21 August when the Lloyds Tour of Britain Women passes through, Flintshire County Council has confirmed. stories.title: Call for evidence opens on ten-year plan for culture and sport in Wales
stories.summary: Sports clubs, choirs, museums and community groups in Flintshire have until December to tell the Welsh Government what culture and sport in Wales should look like by 2036. A call for evidence opened on Wednesday and closes at midday on Friday 18 December. It is the first stage of a new Culture and Sport Strategy
